date_display_zh: 2026 年 4 月 19 日·星期日
tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: 範例：Anthropic 發表 Claude 5，首個在 AIME 與 GPQA 同時超越人類專家的模型
articles.title_en: Example: Anthropic Unveils Claude 5, First Model to Surpass Human Experts on AIME and GPQA
articles.lede_zh: Claude 5 於美國數學邀請賽（AIME）取得 96% 正確率，在博士級科學推理測驗 GPQA Diamond 達 89%，均首度全面超越人類頂尖專家平均水準。公司強調此次進步來自「延伸思考」架構，而非單純擴大參數。
articles.lede_en: Claude 5 achieved 96% on AIME and 89% on GPQA Diamond, surpassing top human experts on both benchmarks. The company attributes gains to an extended-thinking architecture rather than raw parameter scaling.
bullets_zh: Claude 5 於 AIME 取得 96% 正確率，GPQA Diamond 達 89%，首度全面超越人類頂尖專家平均
進步關鍵為新的「延伸思考」架構，允許模型在回覆前自主分配推理算力
定價與 Claude 4 持平，企業版今日開放；研究人員指出評測飽和問題已逼近
bullets_en: Claude 5 posts 96% on AIME and 89% on GPQA Diamond, beating top human expert averages
Gains credited to extended-thinking architecture that auto-allocates reasoning compute
Pricing matches Claude 4; researchers flag growing benchmark saturation concerns

articles.title_zh: 範例：DeepMind 新論文展示 AlphaFold 變體預測蛋白質動態
articles.title_en: Example: New DeepMind Paper Shows AlphaFold Variant Predicts Protein Dynamics
articles.lede_zh: DeepMind 團隊發表於 Nature 的新研究將 AlphaFold 擴展到預測蛋白質構型變化，而非僅靜態結構。這可能加速藥物設計與酶工程研究。
articles.lede_en: A DeepMind paper in Nature extends AlphaFold to predict protein conformational dynamics, not just static structures, with potential applications in drug design and enzyme engineering.
bullets_zh: 新模型可預測蛋白質在溶液中的構型轉換，精度接近分子動力學模擬
訓練資料包含 230 萬條軌跡，比前代擴大 15 倍
預計開源權重與推理程式碼，時程未定
bullets_en: Model predicts conformational transitions with accuracy near full MD simulations
Trained on 2.3M trajectories, 15x larger than prior dataset
Weights and inference code planned for open release, timeline TBD

articles.title_zh: 範例：Apple Vision Pro 2 傳 6 月 WWDC 發表，重量減輕 40%
articles.title_en: Example: Apple Vision Pro 2 Reportedly Arriving at June WWDC, 40% Lighter
articles.lede_zh: 供應鏈消息指出 Apple 將在今年 WWDC 發表第二代 Vision Pro，重量降至約 370 克，並改用 M5 晶片。售價據傳降至 2499 美元。
articles.lede_en: Supply-chain sources indicate Apple will announce a second-generation Vision Pro at WWDC, weighing around 370g and powered by M5. Price reportedly drops to $2,499.
bullets_zh: 新版重量約 370 克，較初代減輕 40%，改善長時間配戴體驗
改用 M5 晶片與第二代 R1 協處理器，功耗降低
售價據傳 2499 美元，較初代 3499 美元大幅下降
bullets_en: Weight drops to ~370g, 40% lighter than original, targeting extended wear
M5 chip and second-gen R1 coprocessor cited for lower power draw
Price reportedly $2,499, significantly below original $3,499

articles.title_zh: 範例：Rust 1.89 正式發布，async trait 進入穩定版
articles.title_en: Example: Rust 1.89 Released, Stabilizes async trait
articles.lede_zh: Rust 團隊今日發布 1.89，async fn in traits 正式進入穩定版。這項歷經 5 年 RFC 討論的功能解決了非同步程式庫設計的長期痛點。
articles.lede_en: Rust 1.89 ships today with async fn in traits finally stabilized after five years of RFC discussion, resolving a long-standing pain point in async library design.
bullets_zh: async trait 在編譯器層原生支援，取代第三方 macro 方案
新增 let-chain 與 c-str literal 等語法糖
編譯器 LTO 效能提升 8%，rustc 自身受益
bullets_en: Async trait support baked into the compiler, replacing third-party macro workarounds
Adds let-chains and c-str literals among new syntax sugar
LTO performance improves 8%, benefiting rustc itself

articles.title_zh: 範例：AI 基礎設施公司 Substrate 完成 B 輪融資 3 億美元
articles.title_en: Example: AI Infrastructure Startup Substrate Closes $300M Series B
articles.lede_zh: 專注於 GPU 排程與模型服務的新創 Substrate 完成 3 億美元 B 輪融資，估值達 25 億美元。Founders Fund 與 a16z 共同領投。
articles.lede_en: Substrate, a startup focused on GPU orchestration and model serving, closed a $300M Series B at a $2.5B valuation, co-led by Founders Fund and a16z.
bullets_zh: B 輪融資 3 億美元，估值 25 億美元，較 A 輪翻 5 倍
客戶包含 Anthropic、Character AI 等，年營收據稱 8000 萬美元
資金將用於自建資料中心與歐洲市場擴張
bullets_en: $300M Series B at $2.5B valuation, 5x jump from Series A
Customers include Anthropic and Character AI; ARR reportedly $80M
Funding earmarked for owned data centers and European expansion

articles.title_zh: 範例：MIT 團隊於 Nature 發表室溫超導材料重現實驗失敗
articles.title_en: Example: MIT Team Reports Failed Replication of Room-Temperature Superconductor in Nature
articles.lede_zh: MIT 物理團隊試圖重現去年引發轟動的 LK-99 改進材料，在六個月的系統性實驗後未能觀察到零電阻現象。原作者尚未回應。
articles.lede_en: An MIT physics group attempted to replicate last year's widely-publicized LK-99 variant and failed to observe zero resistance after six months of systematic experiments. Original authors have not responded.
bullets_zh: MIT 團隊使用三種合成路徑，均未觀察到超導相變
論文指出原始樣品的反磁性可能來自硫化銅雜質
凝態物理社群呼籲回歸嚴謹同儕審查流程
bullets_en: MIT team tried three synthesis routes, none showed superconducting transition
Paper attributes original diamagnetism to copper sulfide impurity
Condensed-matter community calls for return to rigorous peer review

articles.title_zh: 範例：台積電 2 奈米試產良率突破 70%，新竹廠下季量產
articles.title_en: Example: TSMC 2nm Trial Yield Tops 70%, Hsinchu Fab Enters Mass Production Next Quarter
articles.lede_zh: 台積電 2 奈米製程試產良率已突破 70%，預計第三季在新竹寶山廠啟動量產。Apple 與 NVIDIA 均已確認下單。
articles.lede_en: TSMC's 2nm trial yields have surpassed 70%, with mass production slated to begin in Q3 at the Hsinchu Baoshan fab. Apple and NVIDIA have confirmed orders.
bullets_zh: 試產良率突破 70%，優於原訂 65% 目標，時程提前兩個月
首波客戶為 Apple A20 與 NVIDIA Rubin 架構 GPU
單位晶圓售價據傳 3 萬美元，較 3 奈米高 50%
bullets_en: Trial yield tops 70%, beating 65% target and pulling timeline in by two months
First customers are Apple's A20 and NVIDIA's Rubin-architecture GPUs
Per-wafer price reportedly $30K, 50% above 3nm node

articles.title_zh: 範例：歐盟 AI Act 全面生效，企業合規成本估計每年 200 億歐元
articles.title_en: Example: EU AI Act Takes Full Effect, Corporate Compliance Costs Estimated at €20B/year
articles.lede_zh: 歐盟《AI Act》今日全面生效，包括基礎模型透明度要求與高風險系統認證。歐盟委員會估計全體企業年合規成本約 200 億歐元。
articles.lede_en: The EU AI Act takes full effect today, including foundation-model transparency requirements and high-risk system certification. The Commission estimates total corporate compliance costs at €20B annually.
bullets_zh: 基礎模型業者須公開訓練資料摘要與算力用量
高風險系統需通過第三方認證，違規最高罰款為全球營收 7%
Meta 與 OpenAI 已暫緩歐盟地區部分產品上線
bullets_en: Foundation model providers must publish training data summaries and compute usage
High-risk systems require third-party certification; fines up to 7% of global revenue
Meta and OpenAI have paused rollout of some EU products
